exampleSentences.zh: 這是公園裡現存最古老的樹。

exampleSentences.en: The experiment compared living organisms with nonliving material.
exampleSentences.zh: 該實驗比較了生物與非生物材料。

living.mnemonicHint: live 去 e 加 ing：正在活著或生活。

exampleSentences.en: A mass of clouds covered the mountain.
exampleSentences.zh: 一大片雲遮住了山。

exampleSentences.en: The object’s mass remains constant even when gravity changes.
exampleSentences.zh: 即使重力改變，物體的質量仍維持不變。

mass.mnemonicHint: mass 有「聚成一大團」的畫面。

exampleSentences.en: This soap is made with natural ingredients.
exampleSentences.zh: 這塊肥皂由天然成分製成。

exampleSentences.en: Natural selection favors traits that improve reproductive success.
exampleSentences.zh: 自然選擇有利於能提高繁殖成功率的特徵。

natural.mnemonicHint: nature 自然 + al 形容詞字尾。

exampleSentences.en: My professor answered the question after class.
exampleSentences.zh: 我的教授在下課後回答了問題。

exampleSentences.en: The professor challenged the prevailing interpretation of the data.
exampleSentences.zh: 這位教授質疑了對資料的主流詮釋。

professor.mnemonicHint: profess 宣稱專業知識 + or 人：教授。

exampleSentences.en: The mirror reflects the morning light.
exampleSentences.zh: 鏡子映照著晨光。

exampleSentences.en: The survey reflects changing attitudes toward remote work.
exampleSentences.zh: 該調查反映人們對遠距工作的態度正在改變。

reflects.mnemonicHint: re- 回 + flect 彎：把光彎回來就是反射。

exampleSentences.en: Please report the broken streetlight.
exampleSentences.zh: 請通報故障的路燈。

exampleSentences.en: The report identifies major gaps in regional health care.
exampleSentences.zh: 該報告指出區域醫療照護的主要缺口。

report.mnemonicHint: re- 回 + port 帶：把消息帶回來就是報告。

exampleSentences.en: Wait a second while I find my keys.
exampleSentences.zh: 等我一下，我找找鑰匙。

exampleSentences.en: The second experiment confirmed the initial finding.
exampleSentences.zh: 第二項實驗證實了最初的發現。

second.mnemonicHint: second 可記成時鐘的第二種指針：秒針。

exampleSentences.en: Dinner will be ready soon.
exampleSentences.zh: 晚餐很快就好了。

exampleSentences.en: Without intervention, water demand may soon exceed supply.
exampleSentences.zh: 若不介入，用水需求可能很快超過供給。

soon.mnemonicHint: soon 雙 o 像兩個靠近的時鐘，表示很快。

exampleSentences.en: We play sports after school on Fridays.
exampleSentences.zh: 我們星期五放學後會做運動。

exampleSentences.en: Participation in sports is associated with improved mental health.
exampleSentences.zh: 參與體育活動與心理健康改善有關。

sports.mnemonicHint: sport 加 s，泛指各種體育活動。

exampleSentences.en: Her small bakery became a success.
exampleSentences.zh: 她的小麵包店經營成功了。

exampleSentences.en: The program’s success depends on sustained public funding.
exampleSentences.zh: 該計畫的成功取決於持續的公共資助。

success.mnemonicHint: suc- 從下 + cess 走：一步步走上去就是成功。

exampleSentences.en: I have a theory about why the door keeps sticking.
exampleSentences.zh: 我有一個理論，可以解釋這扇門為何一直卡住。

exampleSentences.en: The theory predicts how markets respond to limited information.
exampleSentences.zh: 該理論預測市場如何回應有限資訊。

theory.mnemonicHint: theory 是用一套想法來觀看與解釋現象。

exampleSentences.en: I prefer to study alone at night.
exampleSentences.zh: 我喜歡晚上獨自讀書。

exampleSentences.en: Economic growth alone cannot guarantee social well-being.
exampleSentences.zh: 僅靠經濟成長無法保障社會福祉。

exampleSentences.en: We saw modern art at the museum.
exampleSentences.zh: 我們在博物館欣賞了現代藝術。

exampleSentences.en: Public art can strengthen a community’s cultural identity.
exampleSentences.zh: 公共藝術能強化社區的文化認同。

art.mnemonicHint: art 是 artist 與 artistic 的核心字根。

exampleSentences.en: The nurse took a small blood sample.
exampleSentences.zh: 護理師抽取了一小份血液樣本。

exampleSentences.en: Blood carries oxygen from the lungs to tissues throughout the body.
exampleSentences.zh: 血液把氧氣從肺部送到全身組織。

blood.mnemonicHint: blood 與 bleed 都和流血有關。

exampleSentences.en: She made the title bold so it was easy to see.
exampleSentences.zh: 她把標題設成粗體，讓它更容易看見。

exampleSentences.en: The government adopted a bold strategy to curb emissions.
exampleSentences.zh: 政府採取大膽策略以抑制排放。

bold.mnemonicHint: bold 的 b 像挺胸站立，記住「大膽」。

exampleSentences.en: This color looks warmer in sunlight.
exampleSentences.zh: 這個顏色在陽光下看起來更暖。

exampleSentences.en: Leaf color can indicate changes in nutrient availability.
exampleSentences.zh: 葉片顏色可顯示養分供應的變化。

color.mnemonicHint: colorful 是充滿 color 顏色的。

exampleSentences.en: Contact me when you arrive at the station.
exampleSentences.zh: 你到車站時聯絡我。

exampleSentences.en: Direct contact with infected animals increases transmission risk.
exampleSentences.zh: 直接接觸受感染動物會提高傳播風險。

contact.mnemonicHint: con- 一起 + tact 觸碰：接觸並建立聯絡。

exampleSentences.en: The town depends on tourists for economic activity.
exampleSentences.zh: 這座城鎮的經濟活動仰賴觀光客。

exampleSentences.en: Economic inequality can limit access to higher education.
exampleSentences.zh: 經濟不平等可能限制取得高等教育的機會。

economic.mnemonicHint: economic 關乎 economy 經濟；economical 則是節省的。

exampleSentences.en: We joined an environmental cleanup on Saturday.
exampleSentences.zh: 我們星期六參加了環境清潔活動。

exampleSentences.en: Environmental regulation can reduce industrial pollution.
exampleSentences.zh: 環境法規可以減少工業污染。

environmental.mnemonicHint: environment 環境 + al 形容詞字尾。

exampleSentences.en: The wet floor was evidence that it had rained.
exampleSentences.zh: 濕地板是剛下過雨的跡象。

exampleSentences.en: The available evidence does not establish a causal relationship.
exampleSentences.zh: 現有證據無法證實因果關係。

evidence.mnemonicHint: e- 出 + vid 看：能被看出來的就是證據。

exampleSentences.en: Her family has been farming here for generations.
exampleSentences.zh: 她的家族世代都在這裡務農。

exampleSentences.en: Sustainable farming can protect soil while maintaining crop yields.
exampleSentences.zh: 永續農業能在維持產量的同時保護土壤。

farming.mnemonicHint: farm 加 ing，就是持續從事耕作。

exampleSentences.en: Several farms sell fresh eggs at this market.
exampleSentences.zh: 好幾座農場在這個市場販售新鮮雞蛋。

exampleSentences.en: Small farms often lack access to affordable credit.
exampleSentences.zh: 小型農場往往難以取得負擔得起的信貸。

farms.mnemonicHint: farm 加 s 可表示多座農場。

exampleSentences.en: The sales figures look better this month.
exampleSentences.zh: 這個月的銷售數字看起來更好。

exampleSentences.en: Official figures indicate a gradual decline in unemployment.
exampleSentences.zh: 官方數據顯示失業率逐漸下降。

figures.mnemonicHint: figure 加 s，可指多個數字或圖形。

exampleSentences.en: I cannot focus while the television is on.
exampleSentences.zh: 電視開著時我無法專心。

exampleSentences.en: The analysis focuses on the long-term effects of migration.
exampleSentences.zh: 該分析聚焦於移民的長期影響。

focus.mnemonicHint: focus 想成相機對焦，把注意力集中。

exampleSentences.en: We packed a healthy lunch for the hike.
exampleSentences.zh: 我們為健行準備了健康的午餐。

exampleSentences.en: A healthy labor market requires both mobility and job security.
exampleSentences.zh: 健全的勞動市場同時需要流動性與工作保障。

healthy.mnemonicHint: health 健康 + y，充滿健康狀態。

exampleSentences.en: One answer on my form was incorrect.
exampleSentences.zh: 我的表格上有一個答案不正確。

exampleSentences.en: The conclusion is incorrect because it ignores contradictory evidence.
exampleSentences.zh: 該結論因忽略相反證據而不正確。

incorrect.mnemonicHint: in- 不 + correct 正確：不正確。

exampleSentences.en: I left the spare key with my neighbor.
exampleSentences.zh: 我把備用鑰匙留給鄰居。

exampleSentences.en: Public trust is a key factor in successful policy implementation.
exampleSentences.zh: 公眾信任是政策成功落實的關鍵因素。

key.mnemonicHint: key 能開鎖，也能開啟問題的答案。

exampleSentences.en: We have limited time before the train leaves.
exampleSentences.zh: 火車出發前，我們的時間有限。

exampleSentences.en: The findings have limited applicability beyond urban populations.
exampleSentences.zh: 這些發現對都市人口以外的適用性有限。

limited.mnemonicHint: limit 界線 + ed：被界線限制住的。

exampleSentences.en: The firefighters saved two lives.
exampleSentences.zh: 消防員挽救了兩條生命。

exampleSentences.en: Air pollution shortens millions of lives worldwide.
exampleSentences.zh: 空氣污染縮短了全球數百萬人的壽命。

lives.mnemonicHint: life 的 f 變 v 加 es，複數是 lives。

exampleSentences.en: We learned a lot during the workshop.
exampleSentences.zh: 我們在工作坊中學到了很多。

exampleSentences.en: A lot of variation remains unexplained by the model.
exampleSentences.zh: 模型仍無法解釋大量變異。

lot.mnemonicHint: a lot of 是「很多」；lot 也可指一批東西。

exampleSentences.en: This jacket is made from recycled material.
exampleSentences.zh: 這件外套由回收材料製成。

exampleSentences.en: The archive provides valuable material for historical research.
exampleSentences.zh: 該檔案館為歷史研究提供寶貴素材。

material.mnemonicHint: mater 母體 + ial：構成事物的材料。

exampleSentences.en: This method makes the stain easier to remove.
exampleSentences.zh: 這個方法讓污漬更容易去除。

exampleSentences.en: The researchers adopted a mixed-method approach to data collection.
exampleSentences.zh: 研究人員採用混合方法蒐集資料。

method.mnemonicHint: method 是做事沿著 meta 路徑前進的方法。

exampleSentences.en: I listen to music while cooking.
exampleSentences.zh: 我做飯時會聽音樂。

exampleSentences.en: Music can serve as a powerful marker of cultural identity.
exampleSentences.zh: 音樂可以成為文化認同的有力標誌。

music.mnemonicHint: music 與 musician 音樂家同族。

exampleSentences.en: I am looking for a particular shade of green.
exampleSentences.zh: 我正在找某一種特定的綠色。

exampleSentences.en: This pattern is particularly evident in low-income regions.
exampleSentences.zh: 這種模式在低收入地區尤其明顯。

particular.mnemonicHint: part 一部分 + icular：特別指出某一部分。

exampleSentences.en: Please raise your hand if you need help.
exampleSentences.zh: 需要協助請舉手。

exampleSentences.en: Higher taxes may raise the cost of imported goods.
exampleSentences.zh: 提高稅率可能增加進口商品的成本。

raise.mnemonicHint: raise 是及物動詞，要把某物舉高；rise 是自己升起。

exampleSentences.en: The app reports how much water I use.
exampleSentences.zh: 這個應用程式會回報我的用水量。

exampleSentences.en: Recent reports document a decline in biodiversity.
exampleSentences.zh: 近期報告記錄了生物多樣性的下降。

reports.mnemonicHint: report 加 s，可指多份報告或單數主詞的通報動作。

exampleSentences.en: The library has useful resources for job seekers.
exampleSentences.zh: 圖書館有對求職者有用的資源。

exampleSentences.en: Limited resources force policymakers to establish clear priorities.
exampleSentences.zh: 有限資源迫使政策制定者設定明確優先順序。

resources.mnemonicHint: re- 再 + source 來源：可反覆取用的資源。

exampleSentences.en: Online sales increased before the holiday.
exampleSentences.zh: 假日前線上銷售增加了。

exampleSentences.en: Electric vehicle sales rose despite weak consumer confidence.
exampleSentences.zh: 儘管消費者信心疲弱，電動車銷量仍上升。

sales.mnemonicHint: sale 加 s 是多筆銷售；別和 sails 船帆混淆。

exampleSentences.en: I bookmarked several useful travel sites.
exampleSentences.zh: 我把幾個實用的旅遊網站加入書籤。

exampleSentences.en: Archaeological sites provide evidence of early urban settlement.
exampleSentences.zh: 考古遺址提供早期城市聚落的證據。

sites.mnemonicHint: site 地點加 s；sight 則是視野或景象。

exampleSentences.en: Our local history society meets monthly.
exampleSentences.zh: 我們的地方歷史協會每月聚會。

exampleSentences.en: An inclusive society protects the rights of minority groups.
exampleSentences.zh: 包容的社會會保障少數群體的權利。

society.mnemonicHint: soci- 同伴 + ety：許多人共同形成社會。

exampleSentences.en: I study English for thirty minutes each day.
exampleSentences.zh: 我每天學三十分鐘英文。

exampleSentences.en: The study examines how sleep affects cognitive performance.
exampleSentences.zh: 該研究探討睡眠如何影響認知表現。

study.mnemonicHint: study 和 student 同族，都是投入學習。

exampleSentences.en: The shop sells several types of tea.
exampleSentences.zh: 這家店販售好幾種茶。

exampleSentences.en: Different cell types perform specialized biological functions.
exampleSentences.zh: 不同細胞類型執行專門的生物功能。

types.mnemonicHint: type 加 s，表示多種類型。

exampleSentences.en: The balcony is a pleasant addition to the apartment.
exampleSentences.zh: 陽台是這間公寓令人愉快的新添部分。

exampleSentences.en: In addition to cost, the analysis considers environmental impact.
exampleSentences.zh: 除了成本之外，該分析也考量環境影響。

addition.mnemonicHint: add 加 + -ition 名詞字尾，就是增加。

exampleSentences.en: Although I was tired, I finished the dishes.
exampleSentences.zh: 雖然我很累，還是把碗洗完了。

exampleSentences.en: Although the sample was small, the effect was statistically significant.
exampleSentences.zh: 儘管樣本很小，該效果仍達統計顯著。

although.mnemonicHint: all + though：即使全部如此，仍然有轉折。

exampleSentences.en: The hiking trail continues beyond the bridge.
exampleSentences.zh: 健行步道延伸到橋的另一端。

exampleSentences.en: The consequences extend beyond the immediate economic costs.
exampleSentences.zh: 其後果超越眼前的經濟成本。

beyond.mnemonicHint: be + yond 那一邊：在界線更遠處。

exampleSentences.en: Her doctor recommended regular cancer screening.
exampleSentences.zh: 她的醫師建議定期接受癌症篩檢。

exampleSentences.en: Early detection significantly improves survival rates for some cancers.
exampleSentences.zh: 早期發現可大幅提升某些癌症的存活率。

cancer.mnemonicHint: cancerous 是 cancer 的形容詞形式。

exampleSentences.en: The storm caused a brief power outage.
exampleSentences.zh: 暴風雨造成短暫停電。

exampleSentences.en: Rapid urbanization caused substantial changes in land use.
exampleSentences.zh: 快速都市化造成土地利用的重大變化。

caused.mnemonicHint: cause 原因 + ed，表示已經造成。

exampleSentences.en: The instructions were clear and easy to follow.
exampleSentences.zh: 說明很清楚，也容易遵循。

exampleSentences.en: The data reveal a clear association between income and health.
exampleSentences.zh: 資料顯示收入與健康之間有明確關聯。

clear.mnemonicHint: clear 像清澈玻璃，能清楚看穿。

exampleSentences.en: The island has a warm, humid climate.
exampleSentences.zh: 這座島嶼氣候溫暖潮濕。

exampleSentences.en: Climate change is altering the frequency of extreme weather events.
exampleSentences.zh: 氣候變遷正在改變極端天氣事件的頻率。

climate.mnemonicHint: climate 是長期氣候；weather 是短期天氣。

exampleSentences.en: The meeting ended without further conflict.
exampleSentences.zh: 會議在沒有進一步衝突的情況下結束。

exampleSentences.en: Resource scarcity can intensify conflict between neighboring states.
exampleSentences.zh: 資源短缺可能加劇鄰國之間的衝突。

conflict.mnemonicHint: con- 一起 + flict 打：碰在一起互打就是衝突。

exampleSentences.en: Her explanation is consistent with what I saw.
exampleSentences.zh: 她的解釋與我看到的情況一致。

exampleSentences.en: The findings are consistent across age and income groups.
exampleSentences.zh: 研究結果在不同年齡與收入群體間一致。

consistent.mnemonicHint: con- 一起 + sist 站：站在一起所以一致。

exampleSentences.en: Customers waited outside before the store opened.
exampleSentences.zh: 顧客在商店開門前於外面等候。

exampleSentences.en: Customers increasingly demand transparent information about product origins.
exampleSentences.zh: 顧客日益要求產品來源資訊透明。

customers.mnemonicHint: custom 習慣引申為固定來往的 customer 顧客。

exampleSentences.en: I backed up the data before replacing my laptop.
exampleSentences.zh: 我在更換筆電前備份了資料。

exampleSentences.en: The data support a strong correlation but do not prove causation.
exampleSentences.zh: 數據支持強烈相關性，但無法證明因果關係。

data.mnemonicHint: data 是 datum 的複數，現代也常當集合名詞。

exampleSentences.en: Exercise helps him manage his diabetes.
exampleSentences.zh: 運動有助於他控制糖尿病。

exampleSentences.en: Type 2 diabetes is associated with insulin resistance.
exampleSentences.zh: 第二型糖尿病與胰島素阻抗有關。

diabetes.mnemonicHint: dia- 穿過 + betes 走，古人以尿液異常描述此病。

exampleSentences.en: We discovered a quiet café near the station.
exampleSentences.zh: 我們在車站附近發現一家安靜的咖啡館。

exampleSentences.en: Researchers discovered a previously unknown mechanism of resistance.
exampleSentences.zh: 研究人員發現一種先前未知的抗藥機制。

discovered.mnemonicHint: dis- 去除 + cover 覆蓋：掀開遮蓋就是發現。

exampleSentences.en: Our efforts finally paid off.
exampleSentences.zh: 我們的努力終於有了回報。

exampleSentences.en: International efforts have reduced the spread of the disease.
exampleSentences.zh: 國際間的努力已降低疾病傳播。

efforts.mnemonicHint: effort 加 s，表示多次投入力量的嘗試。

exampleSentences.en: Can you explain how this button works?
exampleSentences.zh: 你能解釋這個按鈕如何運作嗎？

exampleSentences.en: The model cannot fully explain the observed regional variation.
exampleSentences.zh: 該模型無法充分解釋觀察到的區域差異。

explain.mnemonicHint: ex- 向外 + plain 清楚：把意思說清楚。

exampleSentences.en: She has an extraordinary memory for names.
exampleSentences.zh: 她對名字有非凡的記憶力。

exampleSentences.en: The species demonstrates an extraordinary capacity to adapt.
exampleSentences.zh: 該物種展現非凡的適應能力。

extraordinary.mnemonicHint: extra 超出 + ordinary 平常：超乎尋常。

exampleSentences.en: We watched a funny film after dinner.
exampleSentences.zh: 晚餐後我們看了一部有趣的電影。

exampleSentences.en: The film challenges conventional accounts of national identity.
exampleSentences.zh: 這部電影挑戰了對國家認同的傳統論述。

film.mnemonicHint: film 可指薄薄一層，也可指記錄影像的電影。

exampleSentences.en: The form asks for age and gender.
exampleSentences.zh: 這份表格詢問年齡與性別。

exampleSentences.en: Gender inequality remains evident in senior leadership positions.
exampleSentences.zh: 高階領導職位中的性別不平等仍很明顯。

gender.mnemonicHint: gender 與 genre 拼法相近；前者是性別。

exampleSentences.en: The growing puppy needs more food each week.
exampleSentences.zh: 這隻成長中的小狗每週需要更多食物。

exampleSentences.en: Growing demand for energy has intensified environmental pressure.
exampleSentences.zh: 日益增加的能源需求加劇了環境壓力。

growing.mnemonicHint: grow 去掉結尾變化直接加 ing，表示正在成長。

exampleSentences.en: Checking the door twice became a habit.
exampleSentences.zh: 檢查門兩次成了我的習慣。

exampleSentences.en: Regular exercise is a habit associated with improved well-being.
exampleSentences.zh: 規律運動是與福祉改善相關的習慣。

habit.mnemonicHint: habit 是反覆穿上的行為外衣，久了成習慣。

exampleSentences.en: This shelf is higher than I can reach.
exampleSentences.zh: 這個架子高到我碰不到。

exampleSentences.en: Higher education levels are associated with longer life expectancy.
exampleSentences.zh: 較高教育程度與較長預期壽命有關。

higher.mnemonicHint: high 加 er，表示比較級「更高」。

exampleSentences.en: Increasing traffic makes my commute longer.
exampleSentences.zh: 日益增加的車流讓我的通勤時間變長。

exampleSentences.en: Increasing temperatures threaten agricultural productivity.
exampleSentences.zh: 日益升高的氣溫威脅農業生產力。

increasing.mnemonicHint: increase 加 ing，表示正在持續增加。

exampleSentences.en: We speak more than one language at home.
exampleSentences.zh: 我們在家使用不只一種語言。

exampleSentences.en: Language shapes how communities preserve and transmit knowledge.
exampleSentences.zh: 語言形塑社群保存與傳遞知識的方式。

language.mnemonicHint: lingua 是舌頭與語言的拉丁字根。

exampleSentences.en: Please lower the volume after ten.
exampleSentences.zh: 十點後請把音量調低。

exampleSentences.en: Lower interest rates may stimulate private investment.
exampleSentences.zh: 較低利率可能刺激民間投資。

lower.mnemonicHint: low 加 er，可表示更低，也可作動詞降低。

exampleSentences.en: Club members receive a monthly newsletter.
exampleSentences.zh: 俱樂部會員每月會收到電子報。

exampleSentences.en: Committee members disagreed over the proposed reforms.
exampleSentences.zh: 委員會成員對提議的改革意見不一。

members.mnemonicHint: member 加 s，表示團體中的多位成員。

exampleSentences.en: A walk in nature helps me relax.
exampleSentences.zh: 到大自然中散步能讓我放鬆。

exampleSentences.en: The study raises questions about the nature of human cooperation.
exampleSentences.zh: 該研究提出關於人類合作本質的問題。

nature.mnemonicHint: nature 既是大自然，也是事物天生的本質。

exampleSentences.en: I placed an order for two sandwiches.
exampleSentences.zh: 我點了兩份三明治。

exampleSentences.en: The variables were entered into the model in a fixed order.
exampleSentences.zh: 各變項依固定順序輸入模型。

order.mnemonicHint: order 把事物排整齊，也可指下令或訂購。

exampleSentences.en: Mina is hosting a birthday party at her apartment tonight.
exampleSentences.zh: 米娜今晚要在她的公寓舉辦生日聚會。

exampleSentences.en: The opposition party demanded an independent review of the disputed policy.
exampleSentences.zh: 反對黨要求對這項具爭議的政策進行獨立審查。

party.mnemonicHint: 把 party 想成一群人聚在一起：可以是聚會，也可以是理念相同的政黨。

exampleSentences.en: The price of this jacket dropped after the holiday.
exampleSentences.zh: 這件外套的價格在假期後下降了。

exampleSentences.en: Researchers examined whether a higher price leads consumers to assume better quality.
exampleSentences.zh: 研究人員探討較高的價格是否會讓消費者認為品質更好。

price.mnemonicHint: price 和 prize 只差一個字母；商品有 price，得獎拿 prize。

exampleSentences.en: Call me if you have a problem with the washing machine.
exampleSentences.zh: 如果洗衣機出了問題，就打電話給我。

exampleSentences.en: The passage identifies food waste as both an environmental and an economic problem.
exampleSentences.zh: 文章指出，食物浪費既是環境問題，也是經濟問題。

problem.mnemonicHint: problem 是待解的問題，solution 則是把它解開的答案。

exampleSentences.en: The dark clouds moved rapidly across the sky.
exampleSentences.zh: 烏雲迅速掠過天空。

exampleSentences.en: As urban populations grow rapidly, public transportation becomes increasingly important.
exampleSentences.zh: 隨著都市人口迅速成長，大眾運輸變得日益重要。

rapidly.mnemonicHint: rapid 是快速的，加上 -ly 就變成快速地 rapidly。

exampleSentences.en: She gave several reasons for leaving the club early.
exampleSentences.zh: 她提出了幾個提早離開社團的理由。

exampleSentences.en: The report considers the reasons behind the decline in voter participation.
exampleSentences.zh: 該報告探討選民參與率下降背後的原因。

reasons.mnemonicHint: reasons 是 reason 的複數，常用來回答 why。

exampleSentences.en: I need to search my desk for the missing receipt.
exampleSentences.zh: 我得在書桌裡找那張遺失的收據。

exampleSentences.en: Scientists continue to search for evidence of liquid water beneath the surface.
exampleSentences.zh: 科學家持續尋找地表下存在液態水的證據。

search.mnemonicHint: search 是到處找；research 則是反覆深入找資料，也就是研究。

significant.chinese: 重要的；顯著的；有意義的

exampleSentences.en: Moving into my own home was a significant moment in my life.
exampleSentences.zh: 搬進自己的家是我人生中一個重要時刻。

exampleSentences.en: The experiment revealed a significant difference between the two treatment groups.
exampleSentences.zh: 實驗顯示兩個治療組之間存在顯著差異。

significant.mnemonicHint: significant 裡有 sign，像清楚的記號一樣值得注意，因此是重要或顯著的。

soft.chinese: 柔軟的；輕柔的；不強烈的

exampleSentences.en: This blanket feels warm and soft against my skin.
exampleSentences.zh: 這條毯子貼著皮膚感覺溫暖又柔軟。

exampleSentences.en: Employers increasingly value soft skills such as communication and cooperation.
exampleSentences.zh: 雇主日益重視溝通與合作等軟實力。

soft.mnemonicHint: soft 的核心感覺是不硬，可延伸為聲音輕柔、態度溫和或 soft skills 軟實力。

exampleSentences.en: Each student must bring a laptop to tomorrow's class.
exampleSentences.zh: 每位學生明天上課都必須帶筆記型電腦。

exampleSentences.en: The graduate student compared three theories of language acquisition.
exampleSentences.zh: 那名研究生比較了三種語言習得理論。

student.mnemonicHint: student 來自 study；正在 study 的人就是 student。

exampleSentences.en: What type of music do you listen to while cooking?
exampleSentences.zh: 你做飯時會聽哪一類音樂？

exampleSentences.en: This type of bacteria can survive in extremely dry environments.
exampleSentences.zh: 這類細菌能在極度乾燥的環境中存活。

type.mnemonicHint: type 可把事物分成類型，也可指用鍵盤把字打出來。

exampleSentences.en: The airline checked the weight of my suitcase at the counter.
exampleSentences.zh: 航空公司在櫃檯檢查了我行李箱的重量。

exampleSentences.en: The survey gave greater weight to responses from long-term residents.
exampleSentences.zh: 這項調查較為重視長期居民的回答。

weight.mnemonicHint: weight 和 wait 同音；等著量體重時記得有 gh 的是重量。

york.chinese: 約克；紐約名稱的一部分

exampleSentences.en: We took the train to York and walked around the old city walls.
exampleSentences.zh: 我們搭火車到約克，並沿著古城牆散步。

exampleSentences.en: New York emerged as a major center of finance and immigration in the nineteenth century.
exampleSentences.zh: 紐約在十九世紀成為金融與移民的重要中心。

york.mnemonicHint: York 容易和蛋黃 yolk 混淆；城市 York 有 r，蛋黃 yolk 有 l。

exampleSentences.en: No one was injured in the accident near the station.
exampleSentences.zh: 車站附近的事故中沒有人受傷。

exampleSentences.en: Investigators concluded that the accident resulted from several preventable errors.
exampleSentences.zh: 調查人員認定，這起事故是由數項可避免的錯誤所造成。

accident.mnemonicHint: accident 是沒有事先 plan 的意外；accidental 則是意外發生的。

exampleSentences.en: Cycling is my favorite outdoor activity on weekends.
exampleSentences.zh: 騎自行車是我週末最喜歡的戶外活動。

exampleSentences.en: Researchers used satellite images to measure volcanic activity on the island.
exampleSentences.zh: 研究人員利用衛星影像測量該島的火山活動。

activity.mnemonicHint: activity 來自 active；處於 active 狀態就是有活動。

exampleSentences.en: She is adding fresh basil to the soup.
exampleSentences.zh: 她正在把新鮮羅勒加入湯裡。

exampleSentences.en: The committee approved the proposal, adding that its costs would be reviewed annually.
exampleSentences.zh: 委員會通過了該提案，並補充說明其成本將每年接受檢討。

adding.mnemonicHint: add 加上 -ing 成為 adding；短母音後要雙寫 d。

exampleSentences.en: My neighbor spent two months traveling across southern Africa.
exampleSentences.zh: 我的鄰居花了兩個月遊歷非洲南部。

exampleSentences.en: The study traces how changing rainfall patterns affect agriculture across Africa.
exampleSentences.zh: 這項研究追蹤降雨模式的變化如何影響非洲各地的農業。

africa.mnemonicHint: Africa 是洲名，首字母要大寫；African 可指非洲的或非洲人。

exampleSentences.en: The recipe uses small amounts of salt and sugar.
exampleSentences.zh: 這份食譜只使用少量的鹽和糖。

exampleSentences.en: Large amounts of plastic waste enter coastal waters during the rainy season.
exampleSentences.zh: 雨季期間，大量塑膠廢棄物流入沿海水域。

amounts.mnemonicHint: amounts 是 amount 的複數，常和不可數名詞搭配成 amounts of。

exampleSentences.en: The singer thanked the audience before leaving the stage.
exampleSentences.zh: 歌手離開舞臺前向觀眾致謝。

exampleSentences.en: The author adjusts technical terms to make the article accessible to a general audience.
exampleSentences.zh: 作者調整專業術語，讓一般讀者也能理解這篇文章。

audience.mnemonicHint: audience 開頭的 audi- 和聽有關，最早指前來聽的人。

exampleSentences.en: Language barriers made it hard for us to ask for directions.
exampleSentences.zh: 語言障礙讓我們很難開口問路。

exampleSentences.en: High tuition fees create barriers to higher education for low-income students.
exampleSentences.zh: 高昂的學費為低收入學生接受高等教育設下障礙。

barriers.mnemonicHint: barrier 像一根 bar 橫在路上，形成阻擋前進的障礙。

exampleSentences.en: I replaced the dead cells in the flashlight.
exampleSentences.zh: 我更換了手電筒裡沒電的電池。

exampleSentences.en: Stem cells can develop into several specialized types of tissue.
exampleSentences.zh: 幹細胞能發育成數種特化的組織類型。

cells.mnemonicHint: cells 和 sells 同音；顯微鏡下看到的是 cells，商店做的是 sells。

exampleSentences.en: Let's meet at the information center inside the station.
exampleSentences.zh: 我們在車站內的服務中心碰面吧。

exampleSentences.en: The debate places individual privacy at the center of digital policy.
exampleSentences.zh: 這場辯論將個人隱私置於數位政策的核心。

center.mnemonicHint: center 就在中央；central 是中央的，兩者共享 cent-。

exampleSentences.en: It is common to carry an umbrella here in summer.
exampleSentences.zh: 在這裡，夏天隨身帶傘很常見。

exampleSentences.en: The two species share a common ancestor but occupy different habitats.
exampleSentences.zh: 這兩個物種擁有共同祖先，卻棲息於不同環境。

common.mnemonicHint: common 可指大家共有的共同事物，也可指到處都有、很常見。

exampleSentences.en: He apologized after realizing the consequences of his careless joke.
exampleSentences.zh: 他意識到自己那句輕率玩笑的後果後便道了歉。

exampleSentences.en: The article evaluates the long-term consequences of replacing wetlands with housing.
exampleSentences.zh: 該文評估以住宅取代濕地所造成的長期後果。

consequences.mnemonicHint: consequences 是事情接續發生後留下的結果，常帶有負面語氣。

exampleSentences.en: I check the weather forecast daily before cycling to work.
exampleSentences.zh: 我每天騎車上班前都會查看天氣預報。

exampleSentences.en: Daily exposure to natural light may help regulate the body's sleep cycle.
exampleSentences.zh: 每天接觸自然光可能有助於調節人體的睡眠週期。

daily.mnemonicHint: day 加上 -ly 就是 daily；別和牛奶相關的 dairy 搞混。

exampleSentences.en: Nora described the lost bag as small, black, and square.
exampleSentences.zh: 諾拉描述遺失的包包是小型、黑色且方正的。

exampleSentences.en: The process described in the passage converts agricultural waste into fuel.
exampleSentences.zh: 文章所描述的過程會將農業廢棄物轉化為燃料。

described.mnemonicHint: describe 是描述，加上 -d 成為過去式或過去分詞 described。

exampleSentences.en: My doctor suggested adding more beans to my diet.
exampleSentences.zh: 我的醫師建議我在日常飲食中增加豆類。

exampleSentences.en: A varied diet can supply nutrients that no single food provides in sufficient amounts.
exampleSentences.zh: 多樣化的飲食能提供任何單一食物都無法充分供應的營養素。

diet.mnemonicHint: diet 是每天吃進去的飲食；go on a diet 則特別指為健康或體重而節食。

exampleSentences.en: It was difficult to carry the sofa up the narrow stairs.
exampleSentences.zh: 要把沙發搬上狹窄的樓梯很困難。

exampleSentences.en: The species is difficult to observe because it remains underground during daylight hours.
exampleSentences.zh: 這個物種因為白天都待在地下，所以很難觀察。

difficult.mnemonicHint: difficult 是事情很難，difficulty 則是那個困難本身。

exampleSentences.en: The clinic treats sleep disorders in both adults and children.
exampleSentences.zh: 這間診所治療成人與兒童的睡眠障礙。

exampleSentences.en: Some inherited disorders result from changes in a single gene.
exampleSentences.zh: 有些遺傳性疾病源自單一基因的變化。

disorders.mnemonicHint: order 是秩序；前面加 dis- 變成失去秩序，也可指身體或心理的失調。

engineered.chinese: 設計製造的；精心策劃的；改造的

exampleSentences.en: The shelf was engineered to support several heavy boxes.
exampleSentences.zh: 這個架子經過設計，能承受好幾個重箱子。

exampleSentences.en: Scientists engineered the bacteria to produce a medically useful protein.
exampleSentences.zh: 科學家改造這種細菌，使其製造具有醫療用途的蛋白質。

engineered.mnemonicHint: engineer 是工程師，也可作動詞表示像工程師一樣精密設計；engineered 是其過去式或形容詞。

exampleSentences.en: Please lock the window to ensure the room stays dry.
exampleSentences.zh: 請把窗戶鎖好，以確保房間保持乾燥。

exampleSentences.en: Independent audits help ensure that public funds are used for their intended purpose.
exampleSentences.zh: 獨立稽核有助於確保公共資金用於原定目的。

ensure.mnemonicHint: ensure 是讓結果變得 sure，也就是確保；insure 通常指投保。

exampleSentences.en: The bakery expanded its menu to include three vegan cakes.
exampleSentences.zh: 這間麵包店擴充了菜單，加入三款純素蛋糕。

exampleSentences.en: As trade expanded, coastal settlements developed into major commercial centers.
exampleSentences.zh: 隨著貿易擴張，沿海聚落發展成重要的商業中心。

expanded.mnemonicHint: expand 是向外擴張，expanded 表示已經擴大；別和花費掉的 expended 混淆。

exampleSentences.en: I expect the repair shop to call before noon.
exampleSentences.zh: 我預期修理店會在中午前打電話來。

exampleSentences.en: Economists expect demand to decline if borrowing costs remain high.
exampleSentences.zh: 經濟學家預期，若借貸成本持續偏高，需求將會下降。

expect.mnemonicHint: expect 是預期某事會來；except 是把某事排除在外，兩者只差前綴中的一個字母。

exampleSentences.en: We laughed while sharing our worst travel experiences.
exampleSentences.zh: 我們分享彼此最糟的旅行經歷時笑了出來。

exampleSentences.en: Early childhood experiences can influence how individuals respond to stress later in life.
exampleSentences.zh: 幼兒時期的經歷可能影響個人在日後如何因應壓力。

experiences.mnemonicHint: experiences 是親身經歷的事情；累積這些經歷後，就會形成 experience 經驗。

exampleSentences.en: The museum invited local experts to identify the old coins.
exampleSentences.zh: 博物館邀請當地專家鑑定這些古錢幣。

exampleSentences.en: Public-health experts warned that the small sample could not support a broad conclusion.
exampleSentences.zh: 公共衛生專家警告，這個小型樣本不足以支持廣泛的結論。

experts.mnemonicHint: experts 擁有 expertise 專業知識；novices 則是剛入門的新手。

exampleSentences.en: Rita posted the concert photos on Facebook for her friends.
exampleSentences.zh: 麗塔把演唱會照片貼到臉書上給朋友看。

exampleSentences.en: The study examined how political messages spread through Facebook during an election.
exampleSentences.zh: 這項研究檢視政治訊息在選舉期間如何透過 Facebook 傳播。

facebook.mnemonicHint: Facebook 由 face 和 book 組成，可想成把人臉與個人資料集合成一本線上名冊。

exampleSentences.en: Price and location were the main factors in choosing our apartment.
exampleSentences.zh: 價格和地點是我們選擇公寓時的主要因素。

exampleSentences.en: The analysis controls for factors such as age, income, and prior education.
exampleSentences.zh: 這項分析控制了年齡、收入及先前教育程度等因素。

factors.mnemonicHint: factors 是促成結果的因素；數學裡能相乘得到某數的數也叫 factor 因數。

exampleSentences.en: Several families organized a picnic beside the river.
exampleSentences.zh: 好幾個家庭在河邊合辦了一場野餐。

exampleSentences.en: Rising housing costs have forced many families to move farther from city centers.
exampleSentences.zh: 不斷上升的住宅成本迫使許多家庭搬到離市中心更遠的地方。

families.mnemonicHint: family 的複數把字尾 y 改成 ies，形成 families。

exampleSentences.en: The baby stopped feeding and fell asleep in her mother's arms.
exampleSentences.zh: 嬰兒停止進食，在母親懷中睡著了。

exampleSentences.en: Changes in ocean temperature can disrupt the feeding patterns of migratory whales.
exampleSentences.zh: 海洋溫度的變化可能擾亂遷徙鯨魚的覓食模式。

feeding.mnemonicHint: feed 是餵養，母音變化後的過去式是 fed；feeding 是正在餵食或與進食有關的。

exampleSentences.en: This medicine comes in liquid and tablet forms.
exampleSentences.zh: 這種藥有液體和錠劑兩種形式。

exampleSentences.en: Water exists in three familiar forms under conditions found on Earth.
exampleSentences.zh: 在地球可見的條件下，水以三種熟悉的形態存在。

forms.mnemonicHint: forms 可指事物呈現的多種形式，也可以是 form 表格的複數。

exampleSentences.en: This button has no function when the screen is locked.
exampleSentences.zh: 螢幕鎖定時，這個按鈕沒有作用。

exampleSentences.en: One function of wetlands is to absorb excess water during heavy rainfall.
exampleSentences.zh: 濕地的一項功能是在豪雨期間吸收過多的水。

function.mnemonicHint: function 是事物發揮的功能；functional 表示功能正常或實用的。

exampleSentences.en: I hope to gain enough confidence to speak at the meeting.
exampleSentences.zh: 我希望能獲得足夠的信心，在會議上發言。

exampleSentences.en: Plants gain mass by converting carbon dioxide and water into organic compounds.
exampleSentences.zh: 植物透過將二氧化碳和水轉化為有機化合物來增加質量。

gain.mnemonicHint: gain 是得到或增加，和 lose 失去形成對比；weight gain 就是體重增加。

exampleSentences.en: We turned off the gas before replacing the stove.
exampleSentences.zh: 我們在更換爐具前關掉了瓦斯。

exampleSentences.en: The instrument detects trace amounts of gas released by volcanic activity.
exampleSentences.zh: 這項儀器能偵測火山活動釋出的微量氣體。

gas.mnemonicHint: gas 可指氣體或燃料；gaseous 則是氣態的。

exampleSentences.en: If anything happens to the package, call this number.
exampleSentences.zh: 如果包裹出了任何狀況，就打這支電話。

exampleSentences.en: Evaporation happens more quickly when moving air carries water vapor away from a surface.
exampleSentences.zh: 當流動的空氣把水蒸氣從表面帶走時，蒸發會發生得更快。

happens.mnemonicHint: happens 是 happen 的第三人稱單數，主詞是 it、he 或單數事物時常用。

exampleSentences.en: A huge branch fell across the bicycle path last night.
exampleSentences.zh: 昨晚有一根巨大的樹枝倒在自行車道上。

exampleSentences.en: The discovery created huge opportunities for studying planets beyond the solar system.
exampleSentences.zh: 這項發現為研究太陽系外的行星創造了重大的機會。

huge.mnemonicHint: huge 是非常大；可把開頭 h 想成很高，提醒自己它表示巨大。

exampleSentences.en: The exhibit tells the story of humankind through everyday tools.
exampleSentences.zh: 這項展覽透過日常工具訴說人類的故事。

exampleSentences.en: The invention of writing enabled humankind to preserve knowledge across generations.
exampleSentences.zh: 文字的發明使人類得以跨世代保存知識。

humankind.mnemonicHint: humankind 是 human 加 kind，指人這一類，也就是全人類。

exampleSentences.en: Her knowledge of local buses saved us a long walk.
exampleSentences.zh: 她對當地公車的了解，讓我們省去一段長路。

exampleSentences.en: Scientific knowledge changes when new evidence challenges an accepted explanation.
exampleSentences.zh: 當新證據挑戰既有解釋時，科學知識就會改變。

knowledge.mnemonicHint: knowledge 來自 know；知道並理解後累積下來的內容，就是知識。

exampleSentences.en: A volunteer is leading the visitors through the garden.
